Name: Harvey Cosplays as SeanieDew
Author: anystrom
Description:
This mod replaces the portraits and character images for Harvey with him in a cream knitted sweater. This means his green jacket/coat thing can be gone forever, if you wish. 

That is literally all it does.

Manifest.Name: Harvey SeanieDew Cosplay
Manifest.Description: This mod changes Harvey's shirt to a high quality cream knitted sweater. This is the preferred sweater of SeanieDew, enabling Harvey to now cosplay as SeanieDew.
